Crosswalk

Tools and methods

The crosswalk lists 142 tools and methods named in the value chain and links each one to a substep and a competence sub-area. It is the only data that connects the value chain to the competence model, so every such connection on this site is marked as a tool-based link. Sharing a tool shows overlap; it does not make a competency required.
